title: Architectes en kaaƴe
intro: Miijo-ɗee siwil doole, dokkuɗo doole e karallaagal, ina ƴetta hoɗorɗe mawɗe e nder koye. Ndee fedde ina joginoo ngalu keewngu e karallaagal keeringal e mahngo. Kono, hay so ɓe keɓii jeertinaango laaɓtungo, ɓe cuɓii ko laawol ngol ɓe njogori arde e joofnirde teskinnde, nde yejjittaake. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude ndee fedde nde daartol mum woni janngo luggiɗngo wonande miijotooɓe fof ?
clues: Min ndokkaama semmbe e karallaagal, min mbaawi seerndude cuuɗi mawɗi to bannge koye.
En ndokkaama maande laaɓnde ummoraade e Alla, tagoore keeriinde, nde fotaani heddaade nde ɓuuɓnaaka ngam ñaamde.
Renndo men wonti mawnikinaare, luulndii nulal diine ngal nulaaɗo ummoriiɗo e men addi.
Min pellitii bonnude maande kaawis, hay so tawii jeertinaango jukkungo tiiɗngo.
Min njaɓaani yamiroore yo tagoore teeŋtunde ndee yara e ɓunndu amen e ñalɗi mbayliigu.
En kawrii e joofnirde bonnde, nde ɓuuɓol gootol hulɓiniingol yani caggal golle men tooñannge.

location.label: Elemen Key e nder Daartol Men

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verse: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. (26:158)
